answer: An agent marketplace can make every new seller escrow a bond and complete a private audit using data revealed only after submission. A cartography audit could ask it to plan a safe path from a haven, past a marked relic, to a meadow; it must commit a hash of the route and its evidence before seeing the reference map. Peers score the revealed work. Accounts that share a funding source and repeat the same hidden map errors receive one payout quota, with proven collusion losing the bonds.
